summary: Nine games were played on Sunday, and Houston scored a night-high 147 points in a 28-point win at Washington, while Boston beat Dallas by 37, the night's widest margin. Luka Dončić scored a night-high 43 points as the Lakers led wire to wire in Phoenix, and the Knicks came back from 13 down to win the only overtime game, 112-108 in Toronto. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 37 in Oklahoma City's 125-103 win at Sacramento.

games.headline: Brown and Maxey lead 76ers past Pacers
games.story: Indiana led 35-29 after the first quarter and by as many as nine in the second, but Philadelphia was ahead 58-57 at halftime. The 76ers went ahead for good at 66-64 early in the third, outscored the Pacers 39-30 in the quarter and led by 15 at 102-87 early in the fourth. Jaylen Brown scored 31 points on 12-of-18 shooting, Tyrese Maxey added 27, and LeBron James had 15 points and 11 assists. Pascal Siakam scored 31 for Indiana, which was without Tyrese Haliburton and Andrew Nembhard, while Joel Embiid did not play for Philadelphia.

games.headline: Dončić scores 43 as Lakers hold off late Suns push
games.story: Los Angeles scored the first 10 points and never trailed. The Lakers led 104-80 after three quarters and by as many as 31, but Phoenix outscored them 43-27 in the fourth and got within 126-121 with 1:05 left. Luka Dončić scored 43 points with 9 assists and made 12 of 14 free throws, Quentin Grimes added 22, and Walker Kessler had 14 points and 12 rebounds. Collin Gillespie led the Suns with 26 points, and Devin Booker scored 17 while making all nine of his free throws.

games.headline: Clippers pull away late from Hornets
games.story: Charlotte led 70-57 midway through the third quarter, but the Clippers outscored the Hornets 27-13 the rest of the period to lead 84-83. The game had 10 lead changes and 11 ties, the last at 90-90, before Los Angeles scored 10 straight points in the fourth and stretched the lead to 17 at 111-94. Darius Garland had 27 points and 7 assists, and Max Strus added 14 on 5-of-8 shooting. Coby White scored 21 for Charlotte, which was without Kon Knueppel.

games.headline: Spurs close on 8-0 run to beat Jazz
games.story: The game had 14 lead changes and 12 ties and was level at 81 after three quarters. San Antonio broke a 102-102 tie with the last eight points of the game, starting with 1:42 left. Dylan Harper scored 31 points with 9 rebounds, Victor Wembanyama had 26 points, 10 rebounds, 6 assists and 5 blocks, and Stephon Castle added 20 points and 9 assists. Mo Bamba scored 26 on 10-of-13 shooting for Utah, which was without Lauri Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr.

games.headline: Celtics rout Mavericks after 42-9 first quarter
games.story: Boston scored first, never trailed, and led 42-9 after the first quarter. The Celtics were up 67-37 at halftime and led by as many as 41 at 120-79 in the fourth. Jayson Tatum had 32 points, 6 rebounds and 6 assists in 30 minutes, and Boston made 23 of 55 threes. Zaccharie Risacher led Dallas with 18 points on 8-of-9 shooting and Cooper Flagg added 17 for the Mavericks, who were without Kyrie Irving and Dereck Lively II.

games.headline: Knicks rally from 13 down to beat Raptors in OT
games.story: Toronto led 74-67 after three quarters and 84-71 with 8:55 left, but New York came back to lead 95-92 with 19 seconds to go before the Raptors tied it at 95. The Knicks went ahead for good at 109-106 with 33 seconds left in overtime and outscored Toronto 17-13 in the extra period. Karl-Anthony Towns had 28 points and 17 rebounds, Jalen Brunson scored 28 with 9 assists, and Landry Shamet added 23. Scottie Barnes scored 30 for the Raptors, who were without Kawhi Leonard.

games.headline: Rockets pour in 147 points in rout of Wizards
games.story: Washington led by four early, but Houston went ahead for good at 32-29 late in the first quarter and scored 11 straight points across the end of the first and start of the second. The Rockets led 73-54 at halftime, scored 46 points in the third quarter and led by as many as 37. Amen Thompson had 26 points on 9-of-11 shooting with 7 rebounds and 7 assists, Tari Eason and Kevin Durant scored 25 each, and Alperen Sengun had 19 points and 8 assists. Alex Sarr scored 25 for Washington.

games.headline: Hawks erase 22-point deficit to beat Bucks
games.story: Milwaukee led 37-18 after the first quarter and by 22 early in the second, but Atlanta outscored the Bucks 37-16 in the period. An 11-0 run turned a 51-42 deficit into a 53-51 lead, and the Hawks went ahead for good on a basket at the halftime buzzer for a 55-53 lead. CJ McCollum scored 20 points and made all nine free throws, Nickeil Alexander-Walker also had 20, and Onyeka Okongwu had 16 points and 11 rebounds. Kasparas Jakučionis led the Bucks with 25 points.

games.headline: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 37 as Thunder beat Kings
games.story: Sacramento led by two in the second quarter before Oklahoma City went ahead for good at 49-47 and closed the half on an 11-0 run for a 62-50 lead. The Thunder scored 11 straight points early in the fourth and led by as many as 27. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 37 on 13-of-20 shooting and made all seven of his free throws, and Aday Mara had 16 points and 13 rebounds. Darius Acuff Jr. scored 26 for the Kings, and the Thunder played without Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams.
